title: Energy Guards; Vorticity Stretches
mathematical_role: Expose the geometric intuition of three-dimensional vortex stretching while keeping the global energy identity analytically separate.
learning_objective: See a vortex tube lengthen and thin along a stretching direction, relate it to (omega dot grad)u, and distinguish that local mechanism from global energy dissipation.
literal_semantics: The displayed vorticity equation contains the stretching term (omega dot grad)u.
The rendered tube narrows along a labelled stretching direction.
A separate panel displays the global kinetic-energy identity.
nonliteral_semantics: The tube and surrounding streamlines are synthetic 3D teaching geometry, not a computed Navier-Stokes field.
Tube thickness, color, helical pitch, and surrounding streamline locations are qualitative.
The stretching arrow is not a computed strain eigenvector.
No physical energy cascade or finite-time singularity is simulated.

notes: Representation-repair realization follows independent rejection of the SVG-only candidate.

renderer.version_or_environment: requirements/visual-pedagogy-render.txt; deterministic Matplotlib/Numpy raster renderer v4
reproducibility_notes: No randomness or external service is used.
The committed PNG is reproduced byte-for-byte in CI.

derivatives.role: current 3D field-schematic review candidate; not live documentary asset

accessibility.alt_text: A rendered three-dimensional helical vortex tube narrows along an upward stretching direction inside surrounding streamlines, with local vorticity dynamics and the global energy identity displayed separately.
accessibility.long_description: The hero image is a synthetic 3D vortex tube whose radius decreases along its axis. Surrounding streamlines provide spatial context. Two lower panels separate the local vorticity equation and stretching term from the global energy identity.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Pedagogical exposition of global energy control alongside the specifically three-dimensional vorticity-stretching mechanism.

supersession_reason: Representation-layer repair gives the stretching mechanism a genuine 3D spatial encoding while preserving the global/local distinction.
